findings.title: Shared output table grain documentation
findings.evidence: The repository writes a single output CSV at data/UpcomingFilingAlerts_20240901.csv in FilingTracker_Pipeline/01_CheckUpcomingDeadlines.py, and the README.md describes the utility as flagging deadlines due within a notice window. While the README does not state a formal grain phrase, there is no Dim/Fact table and no additional gold-layer output path to assess; the repository appears compliant with the whole-repository grain documentation check because no Dim/Fact tables exist and the only output is a simple alert file rather than a modeled warehouse table.
